name: PageIndex
description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
one_liner: Lets an AI find answers inside long documents (like a 200-page manual or legal contract) by reading it the way a human would flip to the right section, instead of the usual chunk-and-search method that often misses context.
buyer: A legal, financial, or enterprise software company building an AI assistant that has to answer accurate questions from long, dense documents like contracts, filings, or manuals, where getting the answer wrong is costly.
business_use_cases: A law firm builds an internal AI research assistant that answers questions from lengthy contracts and case files with fewer hallucinated citations.
A SaaS company selling to insurance adjusters adds a 'ask your policy documents' feature that reliably points to the right clause.
A technical documentation platform offers accurate AI Q&A over long manuals for hardware and software companies as a customer support upgrade.

money_ideas.idea: Sell API access priced per document indexed to companies building document-Q&A features into their own products.
Offer a managed cloud version with a simple upload-and-ask interface for non-technical teams (legal, compliance) as a subscription.

steal_this: This weekend, build a narrow vertical tool on top of it — 'ask your insurance policy' or 'ask your lease agreement' — targeting one document type where wrong answers are especially costly, and charge per document processed.
